## Summary

Keep **`ws-spec-memo` in this repo** as the consumer **setup/bridge** (`specMemo.*` in `{sharedDir}/config.json`, import, hybrid MEMORY fallback, write-block hook interview).

Do **not** grow it into a full spec-memo product manual. Day-to-day vault ops now live in **`ws-memo`**, shipped by [spec-memo](https://github.com/jpolvora/spec-memo):

- Skill of record: [`spec-memo/.agents/skills/ws-memo/SKILL.md`](https://github.com/jpolvora/spec-memo/blob/develop/.agents/skills/ws-memo/SKILL.md)
- Surface: [references/SURFACE.md](https://github.com/jpolvora/spec-memo/blob/develop/.agents/skills/ws-memo/references/SURFACE.md)
- Records / git boundary: [references/RECORDS.md](https://github.com/jpolvora/spec-memo/blob/develop/.agents/skills/ws-memo/references/RECORDS.md)

If `develop` is not merged yet, use the same paths on the spec-memo working branch.

## Why

`ws-spec-memo` currently routes only a thin slice:

| Moment | Today |
|--------|--------|
| Session start | `bootstrap` |
| New trap | `upsert --kind trap` |
| Changelog | `append` |
| Legacy migrate | `memo import` |
| Pollution | `memo doctor` (light mention) |
| Promote ADR | `memo promote` (one line) |

Shipped spec-memo MCP/CLI that agents never learn from this skill:

- MCP `search` / `get` / `forget` / `gc` / `promote` formats (`raw` \| `adr` \| `madr` \| `skill`)
- `search.sort=occurrences` and CLI `memo rank`
- Vault `spec` / `plan` / `state` (not only traps)
- `memo canvas` (`:4100`), `memo serve --sse` (`:3000`) + status monitor (`:3001`)
- `memo sync-vault`, `export-vault` / `import-vault`, `memo sync` (vault-git)
- `memo hook install`, `doctor --rebuild` / `--fix`

Duplicating that catalog here will drift. Two skills, two jobs:

1. **`ws-spec-memo` (workflow-skills)** — wire the project to the vault.
2. **`ws-memo` (spec-memo)** — use everything the MCP server and CLI can do.

## Proposed changes (this repo only)

1. **INTEGRATION.md** — add an explicit handoff: after `specMemo.enabled: true` and MCP is registered, load **`ws-memo`** from the spec-memo package/clone (`{skillsRoot}/ws-memo` or copy from spec-memo `.agents/skills/ws-memo/`). State that `ws-spec-memo` does **not** own search/get/gc/promote/canvas/SSE/status/rank/backup/sync.

2. **SKILL.md** — after setup/check/bootstrap/import/disable, add a one-line next step: “Runtime: `/ws-memo` (spec-memo skill).” Do not paste the 8-tool table.

3. **MCP-TEMPLATE.json** — optional comment pointing at spec-memo `ws-memo/references/MCP-TEMPLATE.json` for SSE + status ports (`3000` / `3001` / canvas `4100`). Keep stdio `memo serve` as the default snippet.

4. **`check_spec_memo.cjs` (optional)** — when enabled, report whether the host is expected to have MCP `spec-memo` registered, and whether `{skillsRoot}/ws-memo/SKILL.md` exists (warn, do not fail, if missing). Do not vendor the skill body into workflow-skills.

5. **`ws-self-learning` / `ws-changelog` alias notes** — when `specMemo.enabled`, keep current reroute table, but point trap/search follow-ups at `ws-memo` remember/recall instead of expanding this skill.

6. **Evals** — add one eval: “after setup, agent loads ws-memo for `memo search` / `promote format=skill` and does not invent a ninth MCP tool or duplicate SURFACE.md here.”

## Non-goals

- Moving `ws-spec-memo` into the spec-memo repository.
- Copy-pasting SURFACE.md into this repo.
- Changing `ws-spec-to-pr*` plan trees to live only in the vault (separate decision).
- Adding a ninth MCP tool.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Docs state the two-skill split and link to spec-memo `ws-memo`.
- [ ] Setup flow still default-disabled (`specMemo.enabled: false` Recommended).
- [ ] No second full command encyclopedia in `ws-spec-memo`.
- [ ] Check/bootstrap still work when `ws-memo` is not installed (warn + pointer).
title: Improve ws-spec-memo: hand off runtime ops to spec-memo ws-memo (keep setup here)
